detaileddescription.para: SM-01: ContinuousQueryPlanner::compile() accepts a valid spec and returns a plan without confusing the 'spec' parameter with the 'plan_spec' alias used inside evaluate(). The rename is a compile-time fix verified by the fact that this test links and runs correctly against the patched code.
SM-01b: compile() rejects an empty name without confusing it with the 'plan_spec' alias in evaluate().
SM-02b: AQLParser must not crash when given a SEARCH / PHRASE query string. This confirms the file-local TokenType::PHRASE enum value was not replaced by a macro in the tokenizer.
TO-01: A token that is never cancelled causes waitUntilCancelledFor() to return false exactly at (or shortly after) the requested timeout.
TO-02: A token that is already cancelled returns true from waitUntilCancelledFor() immediately (no blocking at all).
TO-03: waitUntilCancelledFor() is unblocked by a concurrent cancel(). Verifies the condition_variable notification path.
TO-04: Two threads waiting concurrently are both unblocked by a single cancel() call (notify_all semantics).

DB-01: observe() on a late-but-within-budget event completes without a resource leak. Because CQWatermark is lock-free and exception-free, this test verifies the path is exercised and the counter increments correctly.
DB-02: observe() on a beyond-budget (dropped) event also completes without resource leak.

IT-01: Wave 1 regression — OrToInRewriteRule::apply() processes a simple or(eq,eq) node without triggering iterator invalidation in collectOrChain. The or-chain has only 2 values (threshold default is 3), so the rewrite will NOT fire; but the applies() path exercises collectOrChain safely.

briefdescription.para: OV-01: Extreme size_t inputs must not produce infinity or NaN.
OV-02: Zero inputs return zero (no multiplication with uninitialized values).

detaileddescription.para: Covers all eight CRITICAL gaps fixed in Wave 1 (2026-08-25):

sect2.title: scope_mismatch fixes
sect2.para: SM-01 ContinuousPlan::evaluate — aliases renamed (plan_spec, plan_synopsis, plan_wm) to avoid collision with compile() parameter 'spec' in the same namespace scope. Verified via compile() round-trip. SM-02 aql_parser.cpp:178 — PHRASE / NEAR / SEARCH / ANALYZER macro-undef guards added before enum class TokenType so platform macros cannot silently replace enum values. SM-03 query_optimizer.cpp:345 — attachPerQueryCostModel parameter renamed from 'cost_model' to 'new_cost_model'; public API is unchanged.

sect2.title: blocking_no_timeout / no_timeout fix (query_canceller.cpp:49)
sect2.para: TO-01 waitUntilCancelledFor() returns false on timeout when not cancelled. TO-02 waitUntilCancelledFor() returns true immediately if already cancelled. TO-03 waitUntilCancelledFor() returns true when cancelled from another thread mid-wait; elapsed time is well under the timeout. TO-04 cancel() notifies all waiters simultaneously (two-waiter stress test).

sect2.title: db_connection_leak fix (cq_watermark.cpp:60)
sect2.para: DB-01 observe() completes without resource leak on the late-processed path. DB-02 observe() completes without resource leak on the beyond-budget path.

sect2.title: iterator_invalidation fix (query_rewrite_rule.cpp:105)
sect2.para: IT-01 Regression: collectOrChain processes a simple or(eq,eq) without triggering iterator invalidation (verified by valgrind / ASAN pass).

sect2.title: multiplication_overflow fix (tensor_aware_query_optimizer.cpp:113,118,123)
sect2.para: OV-01 Regression: estimateTTCost with max-size_t inputs stays finite. OV-02 safeMul path: positive × positive overflow clamped to DBL_MAX.
